## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve the existing Saraswathi Vidyalaya identity and supplied school information.
- Keep all sections usable on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion and maintain keyboard-visible focus.

### Avoid

- Do not invent school facts or present stock photography as verified campus photography.
- Do not add unnecessary WebGL or animation dependencies.
- Avoid excessive gradients, glass effects, and motion.

## Decisions

- Keep the existing navy, warm cream, and muted gold palette.
- Pair editorial serif headings with the existing sans-serif body type.
- Keep the CSS 3D collage desktop-only and use lightweight motion.
- Use original inline SVG icons instead of adding an icon package.
